notes: Starting cards as posted at the top of the list: The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One with the three cards it deploys (Credits Will Do Fine — posted as 'Amex Will Be Just Dandy' — Tatooine: City Outskirts and Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard), Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and Podrace Prep; these count toward the 60.

The '//Starting Effect//' line is a label, not a card, and was removed. The strategy picks the starting effect by matchup (Brisky Morning Munchen against Watto, the grabber A Tragedy Has Occurred against Senate); those Effects and Security Control are posted at the end of the list, so no single starting effect is set.
The title, description and strategy call this an 'E1' (Episode I-only) deck, ticked as E1 in the DeckTech submission. The Coruscant-set Light printings are used for Sense and Alter.

Posted 'Amex Will Be Just Dandy' (a joke name) dested Credits Will Do Fine, the Effect the objective deploys; 'Outskirts' and 'Junkyard' dested the objective's other two sites, Tatooine: City Outskirts and Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard.

Posted 'Obi-Wan Kenobi, Crappy Wannabe' (a joke name) dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; '3P0' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing (the Episode I Threepio that Slave Quarters/Shmi set up, as the strategy describes); 'Palpatine' dested Senator Palpatine; 'Valorum' dested Supreme Chancellor Valorum; 'ASB' dested A Step Backward; 'Qui-Gon's Stick' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, released after this post); 'We Wish To Board Immediately' dested We Wish To Board At Once; 'Lliana Merian' dested Liana Merian; 'Shmi' dested Shmi Skywalker.

'(2) ----> Destiny 5 interrupts.' is printed as written: the strategy leaves the choice open (A Step Backwards, Changing The Odds, Might Of The Republic, Too Close For Comfort or New Leadership Is Needed).
The deck totals 61 cards as published.
